basis: Parameters of the Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 STS pair check, ported from the proven proof of concept; each entry is {value, unit, basis}.

s1.basis: Ai2 truncates the detection centre to an integer pixel, so the true centre is half a pixel east and north.

s2.basis: Same truncation, measured on 131 labelled Sentinel-2 hulls.

k_sigma.basis: A pixel is not water when its NDWI lies this many robust standard deviations below the water peak.

min_drop.basis: The NDWI drop must also exceed this, so a very calm window does not flag ripples.

min_water_share.basis: A window with less than this share of pixels near the NDWI peak is mostly cloud or land.

min_pixels.basis: Fewest valid pixels a window needs for an NDWI histogram to give a water peak.

histogram_bins.basis: NDWI histogram resolution over -1..1 used to find the water peak.

mode_window.basis: Pixels this close to the NDWI peak are the water sample whose spread sets the threshold.

min_sigma.basis: Floor for the robust NDWI spread so a flat window still gets a usable threshold.

min_length_m.basis: Tanker-sized hulls only: a hull B shorter than this is rejected.

grid_step_m.basis: Half the 10 m pixel: the oriented sampling grid is bilinear and finer than the data.

profile_along_frac.basis: Share of the hull length, centred, that the across profile is averaged over.

smooth_sigma_m.basis: Gaussian smoothing of the across profile, half a pixel, removes speckle without merging two hulls.

locate_min_axis_ratio.basis: A pixel blob sets a hull heading only when its principal extents differ by at least this ratio.

hull_length_to_beam.basis: Tanker length over beam, used to turn a length into one expected beam.

min_peak_sigma.basis: A profile peak must exceed this many robust sigmas of the window's own water in that band.

seam_min_depth.basis: A dip between two peaks counts as a seam when it is this deep relative to the lower peak.

min_peak_sep_m.basis: Two peaks closer than two pixels are one hull.

hull_angle_deg.basis: Floor of the spectral angle from the water spectrum above which a pixel is hull.

water_margin.basis: The angle and excess thresholds are at least this times the water's own 99th percentile.

water_clip_sigma.basis: Pixels beyond this many robust sigmas of the water median are removed from the water set.

hull_excess_quantile.basis: The hull excess cut-off is the water margin times this quantile of the clipped water excess.

water_end_sigma.basis: An across profile has reached water when its end values lie within this many sigmas of water.

excess_bands.basis: Red edge to SWIR, where water is dark and quiet and haze and glint barely act.

mask_clean_cells.basis: Closing then opening of the hull mask with a 3 x 3 element this many times removes isolated pixels.

min_blob_area_m2.basis: Smallest connected set of hull pixels that can be a hull B.

slice_m.basis: Length of the along-slices in which the half-peak width is measured, two pixels.

excess_width_frac.basis: B08 and B11 excess counts as hull above this share of the slice peak.

width_smooth_slices.basis: Median filter length, in slices, applied to the width curve before its median is taken.

annulus_inner_m.basis: Local water starts this far outside the rectangle of hull A plus its two strips.

annulus_outer_m.basis: Local water ends this far outside the rectangle of hull A plus its two strips.

annulus_exclude_cells.basis: Hull-pixel cells of the window are dilated by this many cells and removed from the local water.

annulus_clip_sigma.basis: Annulus pixels beyond this many robust sigmas of the annulus median are dropped.

annulus_clip_rounds.basis: Clip rounds for the annulus water level.

annulus_min_cells.basis: Fewest annulus pixels a local water level is estimated from.

swir_bands.basis: Bands whose excess clips the pixels of the annulus water.

b11_blur_m.basis: SWIR B11 is 20 m native, so its half-peak width is corrected by this blur in quadrature.

pair_width_ratio.basis: A hull is too wide for one tanker when its width, or the hull A to hull B span, reaches this many beams.

cloud_classes.basis: Sentinel-2 SCL cloud medium, high probability and thin cirrus.

anchor_margin_factor.basis: Hull A is refined from hull pixels within this many hull widths around the Ai2 box.

anchor_min_margin_m.basis: Smallest growth of the box footprint for the refinement.

anchor_iterations.basis: Most iterations of the refinement of hull A heading, centre and length.

anchor_min_length_frac.basis: The refined hull A is never shorter than this share of the Ai2 length.

anchor_strip_gap_m.basis: Hull B search strips start this far outside hull A's edge, one pixel of blur skirt.

anchor_strip_max_m.basis: Hull B search strips reach this far out from hull A's edge.

anchor_overlap_m.basis: The strips and the grid extend this far beyond the ends of hull A.

hull_b_k.basis: A pixel of hull B, or inside hull A's edge, has B08 or B11 excess above this many sigmas.

hull_b_bands.basis: NIR and SWIR bands of the hull B excess test.

hull_b_min_width_m.basis: Narrowest hull B blob, two pixels.

hull_b_max_width_m.basis: Widest hull B blob, above the widest tankers ever built.

hull_b_length_frac.basis: Hull B blob length as a share of hull A's length.

hull_b_min_elongation.basis: Hull B blob length over width at least this.

hull_b_max_axis_deg.basis: Hull B blob axis within this angle of hull A's axis.

hull_b_plateau_frac.basis: Hull B's across profile must hold a stretch whose lowest value is at least this share of its highest.

hull_b_plateau_min_sigma.basis: That stretch must stand at least this many sigmas above the water.

anchor_heading_tol_deg.basis: The refinement of hull A's axis stops when one iteration turns it by less than this.

anchor_grid_half_m.basis: Half width across of the analysis grid sampled around the Ai2 position.

anchor_cap_factor.basis: Hull A's across extent is capped at this times the expected single-hull beam.

recentre_search_beams.basis: Hull A starts at the brightest ridge within this many expected beams of the Ai2 centre.

recentre_lock_axis_ratio.basis: A starting ridge at least this elongated fixes the heading and the fit does not turn it.

annulus_opaque_cloud_classes.basis: SCL classes opaque enough to drop pixels from the local water.

annulus_clear_min_cells.basis: Fewest clear water pixels around the hull; below this the hull is unmeasured for cloud.

max_hull_length_m.basis: Longest possible tanker; a longer hull A or hull B is a merge or a slick.

tenm_bands.basis: Native 10 m bands, which resolve a seam and two ridges that the 20 m SWIR cannot.

f4_slice_m.basis: Length of the along-slices in which the 10 m excess is averaged across.

f4_along_frac.basis: Share of the hull length, centred, that the slices cover.

f4_k_res.basis: Sigma level of the residual of the folded profile that marks one-sided excess.

f4_min_residual_sigma.basis: The one-sided block must average at least this many sigmas.

f4_slice_share.basis: Share of slices that must show the same one-sided block.

edge_margin_px.basis: Hull pixels within this many pixels of the window border mean the hull runs out of the window.

anchor_shift_tol_m.basis: The hull A fit stops only when the centre also moved less than this.

beam_measured_shift_deg.basis: When the fitted heading is this far from the Ai2 heading, the fitted length gives the beam.

halo_max_b_to_a.basis: A hull B whose peak is under this share of hull A's peak may be a halo.

halo_min_mirror_ratio.basis: It is a halo when it is also under this times the level on hull A's other side.

f4_min_length_m.basis: One-sided excess counts as a pair only over at least this much hull length.

stopped_speed_kn.basis: A ship under this speed is stopped or drifting; a hull with no speed estimate counts as stopped.

profile_bands.basis: NIR and SWIR bands of the across profile and the width curve.

water_sigma_floor.basis: Floor for the robust per-band water sigma.

clip_spread_floor.basis: Floor for the robust spread used in the water clipping.

chip_half_m.basis: Half width of the analysis chip, which must hold the outline wherever it grows.

start_search_m.basis: If the Ai2 point pixel is below the level, start at the brightest pixel within this distance.

peak_percentile.basis: Object brightness scale: this percentile of the raw dB pixels near the Ai2 point.

peak_radius_m.basis: Pixels within this distance of the Ai2 point hold the hull.

outline_drop_db.basis: The chosen outline is the pixels at or above the object peak minus this.

rect_angle_step_deg.basis: Rotation step of the minimum-area rectangle search.

mode.basis: Fixed sensor-based opening width; the relative opening cut real hull ends on wide pairs.

ray_max_width_px.basis: Side-lobe streaks are one to two resolution cells wide whatever the ship size.

thickness_fraction.basis: Share of the object thickness used as opening width in relative mode.

bright_quantile.basis: A pixel is bright when it ranks in the top quarter of the object's own raw dB pixels.

par_start_fractions.basis: Starts of the two-line search at plus or minus these fractions of the outline width.

par_random_starts.basis: Random starts added to the fixed ones, enough for a one-dimensional two-means.

par_min_line_px.basis: Fewest bright pixels on each light line.

narrow_fraction.basis: The radar blur is measured on this share of the narrowest objects of the pass by width over length.

min_bright_px.basis: Two lines of at least par_min_line_px pixels need this many bright pixels.

par_max_iter.basis: Most reassign and re-centre iterations of one two-line start.

polarisation.basis: VH separates the two light lines better than VV on both measures.

length_min_m.basis: Measured outline length, not the Ai2 length, of the smallest pair considered.

length_max_m.basis: Longest possible tanker; longer outlines are merged objects.

width_min_beams.basis: Outline width minus the pass's own radar blur, in beams of its own length, at least this.

light_separation_min.basis: Distance between the two bright-pixel class centres over the outline width, at least this.

overlap_min.basis: The two light lines overlap along the hull by at least this share of the shorter one.
